## Round 2: NEWS

-   A new CUA on this drug has been published!
-   Health gain per patient now estimated at 0.3 QALYs per patient per
    year (was 0.6 QALY), due to more adverse events (auto-immune
    response) discovered in daily practice.
-   Maximum amount of patients is still 500
-   Budget of HCP is same as previously

## Round 3: NEWS

-   Academic hospitals in Benelux can now self-produce this drug for
    **€40,000 per patient per year**, but for a maximum of 150 patients
    (out of total 500).
-   Maximum amount of patients is still 500
-   Price for hospital production needs to be payed from same budget as
    before (HCP)
-   HTD may propose cheaper price with the requirement that no patients
    are treated with hospital made drug
